note: Expected readings are authored independently of renderer output. They are test oracles, not approved screenshots or completed human acceptance.

cases.structure: One fraction, numerator a, denominator b.

cases.reading: one divided by the sum of one and x divided by y
cases.structure: Outer denominator contains an inner fraction; the outer numerator is only 1.

cases.reading: x raised to the sum of a and b
cases.structure: Both a and b and their plus sign belong to the exponent.

cases.reading: x raised to a, plus b
cases.structure: Only a belongs to the exponent. The plus sign and b follow the superscript expression at baseline.

cases.reading: x subscript i plus one, squared
cases.structure: i, plus, and 1 form one subscript. 2 is the superscript on x.
The leading minus is outside the base of the superscript.
Parentheses visibly include both minus and x; the exponent follows the closing parenthesis.

cases.reading: the cube root of the sum of a and b
cases.structure: 3 is the root index; the radical covers a plus b.

cases.reading: the sum of i as i ranges from one to n
cases.structure: i equals 1 is the lower bound; n is the upper bound; the summand is i.

cases.reading: the integral from zero to infinity of e to the negative x, with respect to x
cases.structure: Bounds attach to the integral; minus x is the exponent of e; dx stays after the integrand in the same equation.

cases.reading: a two by two matrix with first row a b and second row c d
cases.structure: Exactly two rows and two columns; a and c share the first column.

cases.reading: E equals m c squared; a equals one half
cases.structure: Two rows align their equals signs; the fraction belongs only to the second row.

cases.reading: lowercase alpha plus uppercase gamma plus blackboard-bold R
cases.structure: Preserve letter identity, case, and the blackboard-bold distinction.

cases.reading: absolute value of x plus the text cost dollar five
cases.structure: Paired bars enclose x. The escaped dollar sign is literal text, not a delimiter.
